thread:
rafa: Pushed a new doc focused on Dedicated capacity isolation patterns + SLA wording. it's a consolidation of several old pages. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4758 -- can someone eyeball the terraform and CLI examples?
tina: on it. can you paste the tf snippet inline?
rafa: sure. tiny example for tenant isolation:
```hcl
resource "redwood_dedicated_reservation" "tenant_prod" {
  name          = "tenant-prod"
  project       = "tenant-acme"
  gpus          = 8
  sku           = "h100"
  isolation_mode = "tenant"
  min_replicas  = 2
  max_replicas  = 16
  scale_up_cooldown_s = 120
  scale_down_cooldown_s = 300
}
```
kevin: looks fine. nit: our TF provider exposes `isolation_mode` but older docs used `isolation`. add a note about the alias. also consider adding `reservation_labels = { team = "ml-platform" }` for tagging.
lore: SLA language reads a bit vague: it currently says "SLA: 99.9% availability for Dedicated". Legal wants the measurement window and contract condition. we've historically used: "99.9% availability over a 30-day rolling window for active committed Dedicated reservations." can you use that exact phrasing?
rafa: updated branch to the legal wording. thanks.
tina: CLI example in the draft shows `redwood reserved create`. iirc the actual CLI is `redwood dedicated create-reservation`. we should standardize examples across pages.
rafa: good catch, i'll update.
kevin: one more: the REST header in the serve example is `X-Project` but our API expects `X-Redwood-Project`. small but will confuse users.
lore: ops asked us to document fallback behavior explicitly: what happens when a reservation is preempted or evicted. suggest a short bullet: fallback to shared-hosted with expected latency/cost delta. include sample rollout policy YAML.
rafa: adding a rollout snippet now:
```yaml
serving_policy:
  primary: reserved-tenant-prod
  fallback: hosted-small
  fallback_priority: "cost"
  notify: ["ops@redwood.com"]
```
tina: link checker reported two 404s in the branch: internal infra schema link and a community blog link that 301s. you'll need to update both.
rafa: fixed links and pushed. also shortened some long HCL lines to keep code blocks tidy.
kevin: docs-team style: examples should be <= 80 cols where practical. also add a short migration checklist for teams moving from shared to dedicated (quota request, model cold-warm strategy, certs). one-sentence bullets.
rafa: added migration checklist section with 5 bullets.
lore: approved from product POV, but ops wants scale cooldown guidance: add a sentence recommending larger cooldowns for KV-heavy models to avoid thrash.
rafa: done. pushed again.
docs-bot: PR opened by rafa: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4758 — "Dedicated: isolation patterns, SLA & migration checklist" :white_check_mark:
tina: quick pass done. minor grammar nit in the introduction. will leave a comment on the PR.
kevin: LGTM after rafa addresses the CLI and header fixes (which you already pushed). merge when green.
docs-bot: PR merged by tina: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4758 — scheduled to deploy to staging.
lore: i'll monitor staging rendering tonight and flag any oddities.
tina: thanks everyone. small but impactful tidy up.
